classification_rule: missing/stale geometry fails rendering_correctness; correctly rendered but unreadable major features fail visual_quality; pending review cannot pass fidelity
reviewer: Codex visual review of full-resolution captures; no separate user confirmation
timing_scope: separate complete validation replay; captures excluded from measured attempt

features.name: building silhouettes
features.note: The building walls and roof silhouette are distinct in the opening view.

features.name: span silhouettes
features.note: Three spans and their supports are distinguishable in the opening view.

features.name: major shadows
features.note: Major building and span shadows are present. Fine shadow texel edges remain coarse under the fixed profile.

features.name: localized terrain hole
features.note: The central stepped cut is visible at the frozen target; its rim and recessed faces are distinct.

features.name: new exposed cut surfaces
features.note: Exposed vertical and recessed surfaces are visible. The crossing coarse shadow reduces tonal contrast but does not hide the cut.

features.name: unchanged nearby terrain
features.note: The continuous surrounding terrain remains visible around the localized cut.

features.name: unchanged cut geometry
features.note: The completion capture is byte-identical to the cut capture after 3,599 unchanged-world observations.

features.name: new exposed cut surfaces
features.note: Exposed vertical and recessed surfaces are visible. The crossing coarse shadow reduces tonal contrast but does not hide the cut.
